name: Ali Barbour's Cave Restaurant
what_to_order: Vasco Da Gama platter (for two) · Lobster Thermidor · Kilifi rock oysters · Whisky-flambéed prawns
reservation: Required — email or phone, days ahead in season; courtesy transfers from Diani hotels
best_time: Dry-season night, 20:30 seating, under the open cave mouth
verdict: Book it for the room and the sky — the cooking is confident classic seafood, not modern fine dining, and that is fine.
caveat: No children under 6, none under 12 at the late seating; smart casual enforced. The old alibarbours.co domain is dead — the live site is alibarbours.com.

name: Nomad Beach Bar & Restaurant
address: Nomad Road, off Diani Beach Road
what_to_order: Sushi platter · Grilled seafood platter · Swahili grilled fish · Wood-fired Frutti di Mare
price_range: Mains KES 1,800–4,300, pizza 900–2,400 (menu Jun 2026, taxes in)
reservation: Walk-in at lunch; book weekend dinners
best_time: Sunset drinks rolling into dinner on the sand; Sunday is the social scene
verdict: The default good answer on the strip: guests happy, chef fed, nobody overdressed.
caveat: Big, busy resort beach bar — peak-season weekends run loud and service stretches.

name: Sails Beach Bar & Restaurant
address: Almanara Luxury Resort, Diani Beach Road, Galu
what_to_order: Zanzibar snapper · Ginger crab · Tuna carpaccio · Kilifi oysters
price_range: Top band ($$$$ per EatOut); KES unpublished
best_time: Golden hour — the sails catch the last light; full-moon nights for beach dinners
verdict: Diani's priciest table after the cave, and the one that photographs like the brochure promised.
caveat: No menu prices published anywhere — ask before ordering the platter. Confirm hours by phone.

name: Waterlovers — Tides Restaurant
address: Waterlovers Beach Resort, Diani Beach Road
what_to_order: Daily-changing menu · Handmade pasta
reservation: Call/WhatsApp +254 706 943 216 — small room, residents get priority
best_time: Dinner on the pool deck over the ocean
verdict: Book it when you want the small, careful version of the resort dinner.
caveat: A resident-first dining room, not a destination restaurant — WhatsApp the same morning.

name: Kinondo Kwetu (house table)
what_to_order: Fresh-catch seafood dinner · Sundowner on the water tower
best_time: A pre-arranged lunch when passing Kinondo; or book the stay
verdict: The most beautiful room on the south coast, and you only truly get it as a guest.
caveat: Not a restaurant: no menu, no prices, no walk-ins. Call or email first, always.

name: The Maji Beach Boutique Hotel
what_to_order: Daily ocean fish · Candlelit gazebo dinner
best_time: A long candlelit dinner on the pool deck — book that morning
verdict: For the guest who wants the hotel to bend around them; call before promising it to anyone.
caveat: Adults only, and outside dining unconfirmed — never just walk in.

name: Msambweni Beach House
what_to_order: Swahili seafood, Belgian-French technique · Private beach dinner
best_time: Long lunch on a Funzi/Msambweni exploring day
verdict: Worth a long lunch if you are already exploring Msambweni–Funzi country; too far for a casual dinner run.
caveat: Realistically guests-only unless pre-arranged, 45+ minutes south of the strip.

name: Chale Island Resort (The Sands at Chale)
what_to_order: Eli's Trattoria wood-fired table · Katika Ziwa seafood
best_time: Arranged day visit timed to the tides; the overwater bar at sundown
verdict: Go for the island hour, stay for the strangeness of a resort sharing a rock with a shrine.
caveat: Day access is the honest unknown: past visitors report day passes, the resort publishes nothing — phone before driving down.

name: Leonardo's (Leonardo il Ristorante)
what_to_order: Wood-fired Margherita · Linguine Indian Ocean · Gelato · Tiramisu della casa
reservation: Book for dinner in season; walk-in lunch
best_time: Dinner in the garden; gelato mid-afternoon
verdict: The reliable Italian dinner of the strip, and the correct afternoon gelato stop.
caveat: Roadside garden, not on the sand — go for the food, not a view.

name: Aniello's Ristorante Pizzeria
what_to_order: Wood-fired pizza · Fish of the day
verdict: The local's Italian — checked by reputation, not by paperwork.
caveat: Could not be verified as currently trading with dated evidence — phone or drive by before a special trip.

name: Non Solo Gelato (Diani)
what_to_order: Artisan gelato · Piadina / focaccia
best_time: Morning coffee; gelato after the beach
verdict: Brand-new here; the Watamu original carries the track record.
caveat: Opened July 2026 — expect teething, and no published hours yet.

name: Coast Dishes
what_to_order: Pilau · Mahamri na mbaazi · Samaki wa nazi · Mhogo wa nazi
best_time: Breakfast; or lunch before the pilau runs out
verdict: If it is open when you pass, this is the Swahili plate to measure the strip by.
caveat: No live channel found to verify current trading — treat as a strong lead, not a booking.

name: Swahili Pot
what_to_order: Pilau · Coast biryani · Grilled fish
best_time: Lunch, before popular dishes run out
verdict: Honest canteen cooking; order what the day cooked, not what the menu promises.
caveat: Quality varies more than at the breakfast benchmarks — this is a canteen, not a kitchen with a chef's name on it.

name: Moiz Swahili Dishes
what_to_order: Chicken biryani · Vegetable samosas · Mishkaki plate
verdict: Go early: biryani freshness decides the meal.
caveat: Consistency reports vary day to day — an early plate is the honest one.

name: Karafuu Restaurant
what_to_order: Pweza soup · Kuku choma · Mchicha wa nazi · Fish choma
verdict: Town cooking at town prices; the choma justifies the drive inland.
caveat: Glovo prices quoted — expect slightly less at the counter. No view, no breeze: that is the point.

name: Shashin-Ka
what_to_order: Sashimi of local catch · Vegetable tempura
verdict: The strip's quiet surprise — local catch treated with Japanese restraint.
caveat: Hours conflict across listings and no own channel exists — phone before an evening trip.

name: Tiki Bar & Restaurant
what_to_order: Nordic eggs benedict · Surf and turf · Chalkboard specials
verdict: The dependable chef's bistro for an early breakfast before a day trip or a chalkboard dinner.
caveat: Event calendar moves — check the night before building an evening on it.

name: Shan-e-Punjab
what_to_order: Clay-pot chicken curry · Tandoori naan + pakoras
verdict: The Indian dinner locals defend — verify it is running before a special trip.
caveat: Unverified as currently trading, and reports of uneven service in recent years.

name: Havana Bar & Restaurant
what_to_order: Grilled calamari · Mixed seafood grill for two
best_time: Late evening — one of the few reliable post-23:00 kitchens
verdict: Not a destination; a lifeline. Every strip needs one and this is Diani's.
caveat: Roadside, not beachfront; its own website is stale (© 2023) — the live Glovo listing is the real-time signal.

name: Colobus Shade
what_to_order: Seafood platter · Charcoal-grilled snapper
verdict: The most honest seafood transaction on the strip: fish, fire, sand, done.
caveat: Rustic in every sense — flies at midday, freshness rides on the day's landing; call before a special trip.

name: Mwaepe Fishermen Beach Restaurant
what_to_order: Fried whole fish · Prawns and calamari
verdict: Eat where the fishery eats; ask what came in, not what you fancy.
caveat: Basic conditions; liveness rests on the village, not a website — expect construction works from the 2025 upgrade.

name: Charlie Claw's (Wasini Island Restaurant)
what_to_order: Grilled crab · Swahili Blue set menu
reservation: Book ahead — wasini.com or through Diani hotels
best_time: Oct–Mar; as part of the full dhow day
verdict: Book the whole dhow day, not lunch alone — the crossing is the point.
caveat: No published prices: agree the package in writing before the day. Tour-group waves peak around 13:00.

name: Twiga Lodge & Campsite (Tiwi)
what_to_order: Grilled fish · Cold beer under the palms
best_time: Lazy weekend lunch after the Kongo Mosque walk
verdict: Go for Tiwi's emptiness; eat whatever the kitchen honestly has.
caveat: Mixed 2024–26 signals (one report of it 'seeming deserted'); the access road is best not driven after dark — long-standing local advice.

name: The Salty Squid Beach Bar & Restaurant
what_to_order: Seared yellowfin tuna · Garlic king prawns · Chilli mango margarita
reservation: Book ahead — phone/WhatsApp; often fully booked
best_time: Sunset; kite seasons (mid-Dec–mid-Mar, Jun–mid-Sep) for the show
verdict: Book it in kite season and watch the sky traffic with dinner.
caveat: Last food orders 20:30, bar 21:30 — this is a sunset room, not a late one.

name: The 41 Beach Club
what_to_order: Koroga corner · Local catch grills
verdict: The successor, not the resurrection — and on a Saturday afternoon, that is enough.
caveat: A beach club, not gastronomy; the Forty Thieves lineage is its own claim. Anyone promising guests the original is out of date.

name: Pallet Cafe Diani Beach
what_to_order: Barista coffee · Burgers · Zoodles
reservation: Walk-in; WhatsApp for the desk corner
best_time: Weekday morning; Sunday brings live music and crowds
verdict: The strip's warmest room, and the honest beach coworking answer if the 4G cooperates.
caveat: Open-air on sand: glare, salt breeze, patchy signal. Coworking prices are the brand's central plan — confirm locally.

name: Funky Monkey Cocktail Bar
recognition: Listed on 50 Best Discovery (World's 50 Best platform); Tales of the Cocktail Spirited Awards MEA Top-10 honoree, Best International Bar Team & Best International Restaurant Bar, 2024, 2025 and 2026
what_to_order: Smoked Negroni · Pineapple Basil Smash
best_time: Wednesday salsa night; Wed–Sat runs to midnight
verdict: The best bar programme between Zanzibar and Nairobi, in a courtyard with no sea view at all.
caveat: Roadside courtyard, no ocean — the point is the bar team, not the postcard.

name: Soul Breeze Beach Club (ex-Bidi Badu)
verdict: A daytime sports-bar beach, not a dinner plan — and check the name you book under.
caveat: Brand confusion is real: 'Bidi Badu' no longer appears on the resort's own site. Confirm before sending anyone down for it.

name: Shakatak Disco
verdict: A period piece that may still be running — have your driver confirm before committing the night.
caveat: Online trail 3.5 years stale; expect a hard-edged, transactional late-night scene typical of coast discos.

name: Tandoori International Club
verdict: Part of the strip's real night, on 2024 evidence — check its Instagram the same day.
caveat: No verifiable current hours or phone; take a tuk-tuk door to door late.

name: Full Moon Club & Rooftop Lounge
verdict: Likely the strip's biggest club night when it fires — verify on the day.
caveat: Every operational detail is aggregator-grade; no verifiable phone or hours.

name: Manyatta Club (Manyatta Disco)
verdict: For a chef comfortable in local bars, the real one; guests may want the beach instead.
caveat: No verifiable 2026 status; go with a local driver who knows the door.

name: Kokkos Cafe Bistro
what_to_order: Kokkoccino · Eggs benedict
verdict: The dependable middle of Diani's café life; order breakfast and watch the strip go to work.
caveat: Own-site copyright reads 2020 — confirm the early Sunday close before relying on it.

name: Skippers Coliving
best_time: Book weeks ahead; Thursday nights for the music
verdict: Book it if work is the trip; visit Pallet or Kokkos if work is an hour.
caveat: Not a drop-in café: minimum-stay culture (four weeks preferred), day access only in low season and only by asking nicely.

name: Java House Diani
verdict: Zero terroir, maximum utility: aircon, plugs and bandwidth when the beach cafés sag.
caveat: A chain — send guests elsewhere for atmosphere; the wifi number is a 2022 measurement.

name: Asha Boutique Hotel & Bistro
what_to_order: Friday all-you-can-eat BBQ · Indian Ocean seafood plates
verdict: The compromise that works: a real beach view and a laptop that still charges.
caveat: The wifi data is from 2022; laptop at lunch is fine, laptop at dinner is not.

name: Diani Bakehouse
verdict: Pair it with Kokkos next door; go early for the proper loaf.
caveat: Thinnest paper trail in the café lane — hours unpublished, liveness unproven.

name: Pilli Pipa Dhow Safari
what_to_order: Wasini seafood lunch · Scuba add-on
best_time: Oct–Mar for calm and 20 m+ visibility; Jul–Oct for humpbacks
verdict: Pay the institution price and the day simply works — book it days ahead in season.
caveat: A long day with 2.5–3 hours of road; June–August the kusi chop drops visibility. Dolphins are wild — nobody honest promises them.

name: H2O Extreme
verdict: The seniority pick of the kite beach; confirm current rates by WhatsApp — the site hides them from robots.
caveat: Outside the two monsoon windows (roughly Apr–May, Oct–Nov) there is nothing to teach.

name: Kite254
best_time: Kaskazi for beginners; kusi for power
verdict: The tech-forward school; prices published and fair (taster USD 130–210, obs. 2026-08).
caveat: Same season trap as all Diani kiting — no wind, no lesson.

name: Diving the Crab
verdict: The safe pair of hands for the reef and the wreck; book the day before in season.
caveat: June–September kusi brings chop and low visibility — the dive season and kite season are near-opposites.

name: Ocean Tribe Scuba
neighborhood: Diani (The 41 Beach Club; office at Baobab Beach Resort)
verdict: Sharp, current, and transparent on paper — the modern pick.
caveat: An SSI shop — PADI course-continuers should ask about crossover first. Its whale-shark trips are NOT running for the 2025/26 season, per its own page.

name: Skydive Swahili
best_time: Dry-season mornings (Dec–Mar) for the clearest colours
verdict: If the wind gods cancel the kite lesson, go up instead.
caveat: Closed Tue–Wed; weather rules everything, reschedule window is generous.

name: Go Jump Kenya
neighborhood: Diani (Ukunda airstrip; beach ops at The 41)
verdict: The ambitious one; book the priority slot if the date matters.
caveat: Hard weight cap 115 kg (surcharges from 100); outside cameraman needs a week's notice; no phone published — book online.

name: Diani Fishing Club
verdict: The working charter of the strip — book the season, not the wish.
caveat: May–Sep is largely off-season for billfish; the public site masks its phone — use the booking form.

name: Whale Shark Adventures Kenya
best_time: Humpbacks Aug–mid-Oct; whale sharks roughly Nov–Mar, peak Jan–Feb
verdict: The honest way to meet the migration — sold as a search, not a guarantee.
caveat: Blog trail is years old — re-confirm by WhatsApp before promising guests; never sold as guaranteed sightings.

name: Coral Spirit — Kongo River
best_time: The last two hours of light, on a rising tide
verdict: Do it once and the river end of Diani makes sense forever.
caveat: The whole web store shows 'sold out' — booking is by phone/WhatsApp in practice; after rains the river runs murky.

name: Kaaribu — Ukunda Street Food & Market Tour
what_to_order: Uji — Swahili porridge · Mnazi at the mangwe
verdict: Spend the 25 dollars before any restaurant money: everything else in Ukunda makes sense after it.
caveat: Morning slot for the fullest market and lowest heat; no named guide published — the company registration is the verification.

name: Kaya Kinondo Sacred Forest
what_to_order: The kaniki walk · Digo dance session · Seedling planting
best_time: Morning, or from 15:00 — midday under the canopy edge is brutal
verdict: The most important hour on this coast; treat it as a visit to a church, because it is one.
caveat: Stay on the path, take nothing — not a leaf; no smoking, no alcohol, no public affection; photography restricted, ask the guide. The fee is opaque — agree it clearly before starting.

name: Colobus Conservation
what_to_order: Guided eco-tour · Colobridge spotting
verdict: Go, pay, and then drive the strip slowly forever after.
caveat: A working rescue facility, not a petting zoo — no handling. Report injured monkeys to the 24 h line.

name: Kisite-Mpunguti Marine National Park
best_time: Oct–Mar for 20 m visibility; Jul–Oct for whales
verdict: The reason the dhow day exists; go with the tide and the season, not against them.
caveat: In December–January many day boats converge on the same reefs mid-morning; wild dolphins, no guarantees.

name: Shimoni Slave Caves
best_time: Tacked onto the dhow day, after lunch
verdict: Go with the guide and let it be heavy; it is the point of Shimoni.
caveat: Bats, slippery coral steps; no verified fee to print — carry small cash and take the ticket offered.

name: Wasini Women's Coral Boardwalk
verdict: The gentlest thing on the dhow day — give the women the half hour and the fee.
caveat: Planks are weathered in stretches: flip-flops fine, heels absurd.

name: Shimba Hills National Reserve
what_to_order: Sheldrick Falls walk · The viewpoints
verdict: The one-day green counterweight to the beach — early gate or don't bother.
caveat: Forest, not savannah: do not promise Mara density. Non-resident fee rose to USD 50 in the Oct 2025 schedule — old blogs still quote KES 300.

name: Mikoko Pamoja (Gazi Bay)
verdict: A working conservation office, not an attraction — arrange ahead and pay fairly for guiding time.
caveat: Combine with the village boardwalk and a Gazi lunch; do not expect fixed hours.

name: Gazi Women's Mangrove Boardwalk
best_time: Mid-to-high tide, water under the walkway
verdict: If the planks are sound, the birds, crabs and root-forest are the reward.
caveat: Condition unverified since 2020 — the new Chale boardwalk (April 2026) is the verified alternative.

name: Chale Community Boardwalk
verdict: Brand new and raw — go for the enthusiasm and pair it with Kaya Kinondo next door.
caveat: Three months old at research: no published prices, hours or contact yet. Do not confuse it with Chale Island's private resort jetty.

name: Diani Turtle Watch
best_time: Warmer months cluster the nests; releases announced day-of
verdict: Follow the channel, and if a release is called while you are here, drop everything.
caveat: A programme, not premises: nothing is guaranteed on any given day.

name: Camel rides on the strip
best_time: Golden hour on a low tide, when the sand is wide and firm
verdict: A grin, a photo, ten minutes — priced honestly if you price it first.
caveat: Unregulated and itinerant; overcharging disputes are the classic failure — agree everything before you mount.

name: Diani Art Club
verdict: Go for the painting wall, not a museum experience.
caveat: Small and commercial; find it by the petrol-station landmark — it is not on the map apps.

name: Mwaepe fish landing (BMU)
verdict: The morning that pays for itself — get there for the incoming tide, carry cash and a cool box.
caveat: Some mornings nothing comes in — the kusi and the weather decide; expect construction works from the 2025 upgrade.

name: Shimoni fish landing & new port
best_time: Morning; pair with the dhow day
verdict: For the guide's purposes: buy at the village landing; treat the shiny port as 'in transition', not a market.
caveat: Do not drive down expecting a working wholesale market — as of the last dated evidence the port awaited commissioning.

name: Diani Modern Market (Mvindeni)
verdict: The new centre of gravity for produce — go the morning of a market day and watch a town upgrade itself.
caveat: Three months old at research: the cooked-food court is still settling; coordinates are locality-level.

name: Ibiza Market, Ukunda
verdict: The real market walk; small notes, no flashing valuables, Swahili greetings go far.
caveat: A working market, not a curio market — that is its value.

name: Carrefour Diani (Centre Point)
verdict: Market first for the living produce, Carrefour second for everything that must stay cold.
caveat: Imported specialty depth (cheese, charcuterie, wine) stays thinner than Nairobi — plan around it.

name: Chandarana Foodplus (Baharini Plaza)
verdict: The pantry for the coast's actual cooking.
caveat: Chain site in maintenance mode — hours are directory-sourced only.

name: Naivas Ukunda (The Gate Mall)
verdict: Staples at town prices; nothing romantic, everything useful.
caveat: No first-party hours; aggregators conflict — call before an early run.

name: Kentaste coconut works, Ukunda
verdict: A story to know, not a place to visit — stock the pantry from the strip's shelves.
caveat: No public tours; the plot is unpublished — coordinates are town-level only.

name: Akamba Handicraft Co-operative
verdict: Pair it with an airport run and skip every beach-road 'ebony' stall forever.
caveat: Industrial Changamwe, not the south coast. Real mpingo is heavy and dark to the core — shoe-polished fakes are coastwide; weight and end-grain tell the truth.

name: Biashara Street kanga houses
verdict: Buy the cloth at its source and have it hemmed while you drink the street's chai.
caveat: Kanga proverbs (majina) matter — have a Swahili speaker translate before you gift one. Named shops are leads; the street trade itself is the institution.

name: Madafu vendors (roaming)
verdict: The correct answer to Diani heat, four times a day.
caveat: Individually unlicensed and unnamed by nature — the category is verified, the vendor is whoever reaches you first.

name: Ukunda junction evening grills
best_time: Just after sunset, grills at full heat
verdict: Twenty minutes and small money for the town's true evening flavour.
caveat: A dark, busy junction at night — go early evening, phones pocketed.

name: Mahamri mama stalls, Ukunda
verdict: Set the alarm once — it recalibrates what breakfast means here.
caveat: Category solid, names honestly nonexistent; after 08:00 the mahamri are gone or cold.

name: The mangwe (palm-wine dens)
verdict: With an introduction: one of the coast's realest hours. Without one: don't.
caveat: Fermentation continues in the bottle; hygiene varies with the den and the hour. Guests go guided or not at all.
